is_rolling.snippet: You can submit an EOI at any time throughout the year.
Applications are considered at the regular meetings of the trustees and grants are awarded throughout the year.
we process applications all through the year, and will come back to you within a couple of weeks with our initial thoughts.

deadline.snippet: The current funding round is now open for applications and will close at 1pm on Wednesday 23 September 2026

is_rolling.snippet: You can apply at any time. We do not have set grant-making deadlines.

report.title: Accelerate
report.quote: If you would like to apply for support through our Accelerate programme, please fill out our simple online expression of interest form.
report.note: Programme page and the get-support page both carry an always-available EOI form and no dates anywhere. An open form is not a statement that applications are accepted at any time.

report.title: Achievement Award Scheme
report.quote: Each year, we recognise circa 12,000 Achievement Award winners and invest £3.5m through the Achievement Award scheme.
report.note: Organisations join the scheme rather than apply to a round. Closest the page comes to timing is the annual volume.

report.title: Alan Higgs Community Grants
report.quote: Please read the Fund Factsheet and our Essential Information before applying.
report.note: The fund page has no dates and no rounds. Any timing is in the linked factsheet.

report.title: Annandale and Nithsdale Community Benefit Company
report.note: Three rounds listed for 2026 (05/01, 02/04, 03/09); the last passed three days ago and no 2027 date is published. The dates move year to year, so there is no cycle to roll forward.

report.title: Arts Council of Northern Ireland — Lottery Grants
report.quote: Our Funding Programmes are open to individuals and to organisations. Each funding programme is different, and each programme has useful guidance notes on who can apply, and what you can apply for.
report.note: apply_url is the funding index. It states no dates and does not name a single scheme this row could be, so nothing is followed.

report.title: Arts Council of Wales — Have a Go
report.quote: We recommend that you register at least 5 working days before you wish to start your application.
report.note: Unlike its sibling funds, this page states neither a deadline nor that there is none. The registration lead time is the only timing on it.

report.title: ASTOP — Rent-Free Property for Charities
report.quote: Whether you’re a landlord with empty space or a charitable organization seeking a home, we invite you to explore how ASTOP can help you make a positive impact on your community.
report.note: A matching service with a contact form, no application window stated.

report.title: Aurora Trust
report.quote: The Aurora Trust does not generally accept unsolicited applications.
report.note: Reported rather than written: whether the row belongs live is a separate question from timing.

report.title: B&Q Foundation — Home Improvement & Home-Starter Kits Funds
report.quote: Please note that due to the high volume of applications, it may take up to 12 weeks after the deadline to hear the outcome.
report.note: The page implies a deadline without stating one. Both application links go to Neighbourly campaign pages (HomeImprovementGrants2026, BQHomeStarterKits26) which render nothing without JavaScript.

report.title: Bairdwatson Charitable Trust
report.note: Opened 03/07/26, closed 07/08/26, decisions end of December 2026. No next round published.
